meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

howto.what: 给项目接入 DeltaChat 渠道:安装原生适配器(基于邮件的端到端加密消息),让机器人能收发 DeltaChat 私聊和群组消息,并支持文件附件。
howto.when: 当你要给项目接入 DeltaChat 渠道时触发:安装适配器、在 .env 填邮箱凭据、把聊天接到 agent 等。

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel to your project: installs the native @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server adapter so the bot can send and receive DeltaChat DMs and group messages over email (end-to-end encrypted), with file attachments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add a DeltaChat channel to the project: install the adapter, set mail credentials in .env, and wire a chat to an agent.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel to my project and install the adapter
say_en.note: Copies adapter, installs package, runs registration test

say_en.text: Find recent DeltaChat DMs and wire the first one to an agent
